title: EvoPersonality_ABM: an agent-based model of coupling-strength (K) personality evolution
description: Simulation code and analysis scripts for an agent-based model that adds a two-component coupling strength (K_self, K_out) as an evolving trait on top of Lindgren's (1991) memory-evolution model, examined through the Markov structure (move-transition network) of the evolved strategies and compared against human attachment-style groups. Contains no individual-level human-participant data -- only group-level aggregates (see docs/human_network_weights.csv and docs/PUBLIC_RELEASE_AUDIT.md).
